## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). Credit and rates signals point lower — HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND — while VXX (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -3.54%) BELOW TREND shows modest fear easing, producing a neutral mix.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND. Rates pressuring risk assets: TLT (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND; VXX (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -3.54%) BELOW TREND signals some complacency but not dominant.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tightening. UUP (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL and yield curve flat (policy reads neutral) while TLT (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND implies higher yields are weighing on duration and credit spreads.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Leadership narrow: Healthcare (XLV proxy) XLV (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54%) RECOVERY, Materials (XLB proxy) XLB (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -6.38%) RECOVERY, Consumer Staples (XLP proxy) XLP (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY; Technology XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION and Financials XLF (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND show weakness — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US modestly outperforming EM. SPY (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -0.47%) BELOW TREND versus EEM (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND; China FXI (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND trailing.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed but cooling. IBIT (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +4.24%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.14%) CORRECTION show short-term profit taking, while IWM (1W: -1.95% | 1M: -6.36%) BELOW TREND signals small-cap risk aversion.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Bifurcated: Oil BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ABOVE TREND and NatGas UNG (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while Gold GLD (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND and Silver SLV (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND are under pressure.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed within energy complex. XLE (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.29%) CORRECTION while BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ABOVE TREND points to commodity-driven strength despite sector ETF consolidation.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed weakness in credit and rates: HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND, TLT (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND. MAJOR divergence present across core ETFs (QQQ (1W: -0.67% | 1M: +2.24%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION, IBIT (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +4.24%) CORRECTION) — market is transitional.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor commodity exposures showing strength: BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to duration-sensitive and safe-haven ETFs GLD (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND, and monitor XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION for breakdown.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Healthcare XLV (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54%) RECOVERY, Materials XLB (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -6.38%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION, Financials XLF (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ABOVE TREND, NatGas UNG (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND, Silver SLV (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ratio near 0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF spread at 2.0 (growth vs value tilt), SPY 1W support area as seen with SPY (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -0.47%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength while XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND show vulnerability; monitor credit (HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND) and the large divergence across tech/crypto ETFs as the key risk.
